race.description: Roadside Services And Solutions Mdn Plate
race.comment: WILD IS THE WIND (5) sets the standard after a sharp debut second at Gawler, where he travelled well, loomed to win and was beaten just over half a length by Out Ontario. The extra ground shouldn't bother and the 3kg claim gives him a further edge. PRETTY MORSEL (10) is the proven grinder, with nine placings from 19 starts, three placings from four runs at this track and two from three at the mile. She was plain in town last start, yet her Murray Bridge run two back had merit after she charged home from well back. MAJESTIC MOSHE (2) brings race fitness and useful ratings support despite being unwanted in the market at recent runs. IRON FRAME (1) was well held on debut, but barrier one, Brooke King and prior trial wins give him some scope to improve into the race. STARSCREAM (4) trialled strongly prior to his return in town. Willing to give another look.
